source.title: Crickets chirping in the Night at the Forest 001
source.author: Borgory
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo, 181 s: a cricket chorus at about 2.8 kHz (a harmonic near 5.6 kHz) swelling and fading about once a minute, over two steady layers as loud as the crickets: a low hum under 1 kHz (distant traffic or wind) and a hiss at 8-12 kHz that doesn't swell with them. The 1.5 kHz high-pass takes the hum; the 6 kHz low-pass, twice (in the cleaning and the cut), and 16 kHz take the hiss. The loop runs two whole swells, from one to the next.
